description: Roll out GraphQL federation across 4 microservices using Apollo Federation. Must: define subgraph schemas for each service, deploy Apollo Router as the federation gateway, migrate client queries from direct REST calls to federated GraphQL, verify query complexity limits, set up caching and persisted queries, and monitor for N+1 query issues. Risk factors: subgraph schema conflicts, gateway becoming a single point of failure, N+1 queries causing performance regression, client migration incomplete. Tools available: Apollo Router, GraphQL, Helm, kubectl, Prometheus.
